units.source_text: 本来打算今天离开，可是今晚有个宴会，我们决定推迟一天。

en.t: We had originally planned to leave today, but there is a banquet tonight, so we have decided to put it off for one day.

units.source_text: 如果您非今儿离开不可，那就在下田见吧。

en.t: If you absolutely have to leave today, then let us meet in Shimoda.

units.source_text: 我们订了‘甲州屋’客店，很容易找到的。”

en.t: We have booked rooms at the Koshuya inn; it should be easy to find.”
